CustomField.description: This traveller's own feedback link. Minted by GxFeedbackDispatch when the traveller is invited, and the only thing that opens their survey: the link is ?b=<booking number>&k=<this>, and the survey resolves the person by this value alone, because BookingNumber__c is shared by a group booking and all of its participant bookings. Unique and case sensitive so two travellers can never share a link, and an external id so the lookup by secret is indexed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The traveller's personal feedback link. Set automatically; never edit or share it.
CustomField.label: Survey Secret
